title: Filet Mignon
description: Scotch fillet wrapped in bacon with a mushroom and demi glace cream sauce. Simple, rich, and timeless.

ingredients.notes: Don't add too much all at once — you can't take it out once it's in.

method.instruction: Wrap a rasher of bacon around each scotch fillet and secure with a toothpick or kitchen twine.
Pan-fry or grill over high heat to desired doneness, about 3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare. Remove and rest on a warm plate. Remove the toothpick.
In the same pan, melt butter over medium heat. Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 2–3 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook until golden, about 3–4 minutes.
Pour in demi glace and thickened cream. Stir and reduce for 2–3 minutes until the sauce is rich and glossy. Season with salt.
Plate the bacon-wrapped filet and spoon the mushroom cream sauce generously over the top.

notes.title: Demi-Forward Sauce
notes.content: The sauce is demi glace-forward with cream added for richness and body — not a cream-dominant sauce. The demi carries the beefy depth while the cream smooths and enriches.
